summary: Analog Devices, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten public offering of $3.0 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes across four tranches: $500M 5.100% notes due September 15, 2029; $500M 5.350% notes due October 1, 2031; $1.0B 5.600% notes due October 1, 2033; and $1.0B 5.750% notes due October 1, 2036. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated, and unguaranteed, issued under a 2013 base indenture as supplemented September 17, 2026, with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A. as trustee. Interest is payable semi-annually beginning March 15, 2027 for the 2029 notes and April 1, 2027 for the remaining tranches. J.P. Morgan Securities LLC acted as representative of the underwriters. This is a routine debt capital markets shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for use of proceeds detail and any leverage or ratings implications.
